title: Saudi Arabian Minced Pork Hash
description: A flavorful and anti-inflammatory-friendly breakfast dish featuring minced pork and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the minced pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, kosher salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional minute.
Use a spatula to break up the meat and stir in the crumbled feta cheese.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Cover and refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
